s01094.summary: Helena finds a hidden journal beneath the observatory floorboards and reads it.
Helena finds a star circled in red marked with the word NO.
Grant calls and scolds Helena for going without backup.
Helena follows strange footprints in the dust to a half-open door.
A tall man steps out holding a brass key and greets Helena.
Helena questions the man about Warrick's death and the star.
The man closes the dome; Helena hurls the journal and darkness falls.

s01095.summary: The sheriff stands at a fresh grave with the widow and her son.
Augustine offers awkward condolences and help; Abigail coolly refuses.
Abigail sets the sheriff's hat on the cross as her husband's.
Augustine offers a paper; unable to read it, he buries it by the cross.
Jeremiah takes his mother's hand and they watch the cross at sunset.

s01096.summary: Inez leads her team along the catwalk toward a crouching figure.
Inez advances and orders the figure to drop the briefcase.
Dorothea sends Augusto to find the chandelier cable cut-off.
Inez talks to Violetta, a fired soprano grieving her lost career.
Barnabas raises his gun; Inez orders him to lower it.
Violetta asks to sing one last time; Dorothea calls a spotlight.
The briefcase falls empty, holding only blank sheet music; no bomb.
Violetta sings one clear note while everyone stands still, moved.

s01097.summary: After a narrow loss, Toby blames Rags for calling the hammer late.
Rags slams her glass and insists she called it when the ice said.
Rags softens and admits the team did well; Toby sucks up.
Rags raises a toast to the ninth end and they clink glasses.

s01098.summary: Rosemary belittles Benedict's offer to handle things; Delphine piles on.
Delphine claims she is named in the will; Rosemary says she struck it.
Rosemary sags at the casket; Benedict comforts her and they remember him.
The three laugh through tears together in the wreckage of the fight.
Oswald arrives; Rosemary asks for a moment and Delphine sits beside her.

s01100.summary: The greenhouse crew goes about routine while the commander gazes at Earth.
Waldemar quietly asks Yasmin whether the brooding commander is okay.
Iris announces their mission extension of six more months.
Yasmin and Waldemar exchange a resigned look and accept it.
Iris orders four teas, then realizes there are only three now.
Iris leaves; Waldemar asks about the fourth, and Yasmin defers.

s01101.summary: Luciana pushes Dorian to wake a dead console in the dim hangar.
Imani hears a rhythmic tapping; Esperanza identifies it as a countdown.
Comms reports being locked in the sub bay, tapping on the hull.
Comms says the crew is not in bay four; the tapping is something else.
Lights die and a delighted voice laughs from the vent above.

s01102.summary: Marisol stands on a chair demanding attention as rain ruins the wedding.
Water pours in; three guests dive for the cake and crash in mud.
Marisol laughs, toasts the wettest wedding, and leaps into Adebayo's arms.

s01103.summary: Cordelia and Artemus wade through the flooded asylum cellar.
A camera flash reveals a figure against the far wall.
Artemus wants to leave; Cordelia explains they seek patient Mary Hargreave.
A woman's voice sings a lullaby; Cordelia orders Artemus not to answer.
A pale hand rises from the water and seizes Cordelia's ankle.
Darkness; a flash shows a rotting woman holding Cordelia, then silence.

s01104.summary: Marshal Dunmore rides to the water tower where Odessa waits.
Odessa explains the Whitaker brothers escaped up the tower armed.
Lazarus asks if he'll shoot them; Dunmore answers with dry humor.
Dunmore reports by radio, judges reinforcements too late, and heads for the ladder.
Odessa stops him; a wordless look passes before he climbs.

s01105.summary: Fionnuala scopes enemies from the ruined cinema roof beside wounded Ikenna.
Tavakoli makes noise; Fionnuala snaps and Ikenna steadies her.
Tavakoli reveals which beams don't creak, offering an escape route.
Ikenna crawls toward the beams, bleeding across the roof.
Fionnuala orders Tavakoli to follow and says she will stay behind.
A shell hits nearby; Tavakoli crawls after Ikenna to safety.
Fionnuala rises and takes aim at the flaring balcony.

s01106.summary: Hazel presses Jonah about missing the ferry again.
Eavesdropping Wendell interjects; Hazel sides with him, irritating Jonah.
Laughter breaks the tension and Jonah quietly apologizes to Hazel.

s01107.summary: Milo climbs onto the roof; Sadie silently makes room for him.
They listen to the radio and share a cracker in silence.
Playful shoving nearly sends Sadie off the ledge; Milo catches her.
Sadie offers her hand and they climb down together.

s01109.summary: Billie tests the old scoreboard controls, hitting the wrong button.
The janitor checks in; Billie asks for five more minutes.
Billie spotlights center court and watches the empty circle.
Billie runs the home score to 99 and sounds a final horn.

s01110.summary: Cornelius calls his estranged daughter, expecting no answer.
He tells Mara her mother is hospitalized and asked about her.
Cornelius admits lying that the flowers were from Mara; his voice cracks.
He shares the prognosis and tells her how to visit if she wants.
He recalls her singing messages and asks her to sing; only static.

s01111.summary: Five friends hide in the dark, whispering, awaiting the birthday guest.
Keys fail in the lock repeatedly as the group freezes.
A pizza deliverer opens the door and gets an explosive surprise.
Frosted Tibby claims the pizza from the bewildered wrong-address deliverer.

s01112.summary: Nadia calls a rest stop on the glacier despite Nat's objection.
They rest and share a thermos; Nadia points out the pass.
Desmond insists he can walk; Nat tethers him as the anchor.
The three haul onward toward the pass in silence.

s01113.summary: The crew finds cryo pod 17 cold and empty.
Odalys insists Santiago open the pod despite his hesitation.
Inside lie a blanket, a child's drawing, and a dead monitor.
Santiago gently stops Pixie from touching the monitor.
Odalys orders the pod sealed and pockets the drawing; Miriam comforts her.

s01114.summary: Exhausted Anselmo ignores an urgent page and turns the phone over.
Anselmo recites his workload and reflects on an attending's old advice.
He stands, puts on his hat, answers the page, and climbs.

s01115.summary: Kids in the treehouse tease Winnie about cheating at cards.
New neighbor Lotte offers licorice and is welcomed by the group.
The kids ask Lotte about herself; she's from faraway Rotterdam.
They settle into quiet play; a card lands in Lotte's lap, and she grins.

s01116.summary: Izabella pours wine for her ex Teddy as everyone watches each other.
Camila teases Teddy that he finds the wine sour.
Henrik praises the wine; Izabella reveals he is her fiance.
Teddy congratulates them stiffly; Camila tenderly offers him another drink.

s01117.summary: Felix asks his grandmother why his mother left.
Babcia pauses, then deflects, telling him to eat first.
She serves porridge and strokes his hair; he leans in, then pulls away.
Babcia explains his mother wanted a different life from the farm.
Felix asks if she'll return; Babcia holds his hand and answers with swallows.

s01118.summary: Gwendolyn reads the lighthouse logs in the fog-bound room.
She spots a third entry written impossibly by the missing keeper.
Holding it to the flame reveals a hidden line: He did not fall.
The Harbormaster reports Pellew's empty boat; nobody knows who lit the lamp.
A floorboard creaks above; Gwendolyn pockets the log and climbs.

pd_dollhouse_0.summary: Nora returns home with parcels and a Christmas tree, tipping the porter.
Nora secretly eats macaroons and checks whether Helmer is home.
Helmer teases Nora with pet names from his study.
Helmer chides her spending; Nora argues they can borrow until payday.
Helmer lectures Nora against debt with a grim hypothetical.
Nora sulks; Helmer coaxes her and reaches for his purse.

pd_dollhouse_1.summary: Nora tells Christine how she secretly scrimped to pay her debt.
Nora describes her fantasy of a rich admirer leaving her money.
Nora rejoices at being free from care and dreams of spring.
Krogstad arrives to see Helmer; Nora tensely sends him to the study.
Mrs Linde asks about Krogstad, revealing she knew him years ago.
